notes: Read all 415 source lines line by line before editing. Every line is accounted for below; behaviour, state names, API paths (via the ported energy hooks), unit handling, i18n keys+defaults, and the page's section structure (refresh -> status badges -> stat cards -> battery state + flow diagram -> power history chart -> SOC chart) are preserved. The native file header documents every web->native remap.
L1 `import { useMemo, useState }`: kept; the native file also pulls React + useCallback/useEffect/useRef/ReactNode for the inlined component + hook shims.

L2 react-i18next useTranslation -> inlined useNativeTranslation(): a stable (key, fallback, options?) => fallback shim reproducing i18next `{{name}}` interpolation; every t('key','English') keeps its English default so i18n intent is preserved at each call site (this page uses no interpolation).

L3-6 lucide-react Sun/Battery/Home/Zap/ShieldAlert/RefreshCw/ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Activity: -> SemanticIcon glyph chips for the StatCard icons (sun/battery/home/bolt) and the RefreshButton (refresh); the tiny inline badge marks become variant-coloured status dots (the established StatusBadge native idiom) and the FlowArrow direction marks become ↓ (power>=0) / ↑ (power<0) text glyphs. No lucide/SVG import.

L8 @/components/layout PageContainer -> inline native PageContainer (title variant=title + muted-caption subtitle + the web loading (ActivityIndicator spinner) / error (danger banner) / children branches reproduced one-for-one; children render only when not loading, exactly like the web). @/components/layout Grid (cols 2/4 + cols 1/2) -> flex-wrap layout Views (styles.statGrid + styles.statCell for the 2-up stat cards; styles.panelGrid stacking the two panels, matching the web `default:1` mobile column).

L9 @/components/ui GlassPanel/Badge/Button: GlassPanel -> the existing native GlassPanel; Badge -> inline native Badge (variant surface + leading status dot + label, variants success/danger/warning/info/neutral over tokens); Button -> inline native RefreshButton (Pressable with a SemanticIcon refresh chip, an ActivityIndicator while pending, disabled while pending, and the label) since the native AppButton exposes neither an icon nor a loading surface.

L10 @/components/forms RangePicker -> the existing native DatePresetChips: value={{start,end}} maps to activeId={presetId}; onChange(r) -> onSelect(sel)=>setRange({start:sel.start,end:sel.end}); presetIds={PRESET_IDS} preserved; triggerTestId='power-flow-range' -> testID='power-flow-range'. The web calendar/popover affordance is dropped (no native popover) but every preset id remains selectable.

L11 @/hooks/useRangeState -> inlined native-safe useRangeState({persistKey:'power-flow.range', defaultPresetId:'7d'}) returning {start:since, end:until, presetId, setRange}. Precedence on bare native is localStorage > defaultPresetId > today (the web URL layer has no native analogue and is intentionally dropped); the localStorage memory is feature-detected (present on react-native-web, in-memory only on bare native); setRange clamps to minDate and persists, matching the web setter. The fallback/clampToMin/isValidIsoDate/load+saveToStorage helpers are ported from the web hook.
L12 @/components/data-display StatCard -> the existing native StatCard (label/value/unit/icon/loading props line up 1:1).

CHART_COLORS is imported from the ported native chartUtils so the SOC series keeps CHART_COLORS[1]. Native-safe browser-only behaviour (contract rules 4,5,7): (a) window.localStorage for the remembered range is feature-detected (present on react-native-web, in-memory only on bare native). (b) document.title for usePageTitle is feature-detected. (c) Intl date formatting is applied where the runtime supports it and never throws on bare Hermes. No unavailable-state placeholder was needed — every section renders real data or its EmptyState/empty-chart placeholder exactly like the web.

No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, or Leaflet are imported — only react, react-native primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/Animated/ActivityIndicator/StyleSheet), the ported web-parity energy hooks + datePresets lib + AreaChartWrapper + DatePresetChips + StatCard + chartUtils CHART_COLORS, and the existing apps/native SemanticIcon/AppText/GlassPanel/theme tokens.
